title: clear query from the clearAll widget
body:
There did not seem to be a way to clear the query with the clearAll widget.

The weird thing is there, the method clearing refinements is called _clearRefinementsAndSearch but does not seems to clear the search.

Probably fixable with an event based approach, or an extra option

comments.body:
In addition I would like to have a way to extend this widget to call a custom callback..
Use case is clearAll widget is use app state clear all.

That could probably be added as a single method on the [helper](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js). I'm filing an [issue](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/issues/342) there.
This doesn't clear URL "q" parameter, so if you refresh, it searches for the same query

> This doesn't clear URL "q" parameter, so if you refresh, it searches for the same query

You have now an option on the currentRefinedValues widget to clear also the query: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/currentRefinedValues.html#struct-CurrentRefinedValuesWidgetOptions-clearsQuery
